subtitle: P[0], P[1], ..., P[N - 1] is a sequence containing each of the numbers from 0 to N - 1 (inclusive) exactly once. Applying sequence P to an array A of length N produces an array B of length N. The method of application is B[P[i]] = A[i]. Given array A, write a program that finds the sequence P such that the result of applying P is non-decreasing. Non-decreasing means each element is greater than or equal to the element immediately before it. If there are multiple such sequences, print the one that comes first in lexicographic order.
